annotations.text:
UI brief for issue #7 — Dispatch Solar Mapping

Direction: Dispatch Energy's own palette — white and near-white, near-black text, their greys for rules, and one accent: Dispatch green #006400 for eyebrow labels, links, the success state and every data mark. Poppins headings with wide-tracked green labels; flat 2px cards, hairline rules, no shadows.

Hierarchy rule: a site's own information leads — name, location, PVWatts estimate, solar resource. Machinery (processing stages, sites without results) folds away until it is the thing you need.

A stage that produced nothing shows nothing — never a zero, never a stale value. The stage panel is collapsed while all three succeed, and opens itself the moment one fails or is blocked: that is when it stops being machinery and becomes the answer.

Decided (was: open questions)

1. Fixed import order — no sorting or filtering.
2. A site being imported greys out and reads "processing"; on an outcome it joins the results list or the folded "not on the map" group.
3. Phone keeps the chart AND the monthly table; the site list and the stages collapse instead.
4. No revision history is stored: nothing in the UI implies one, and a conflict never surfaces a deactivated record.
